title: fix(wordcount): preserve table cell word boundaries
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Preserve lexical boundaries between adjacent GFM table cells so Markdown-aware word counts do not merge unrelated cell contents.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

`countMarkdown()` traversed table cells correctly but concatenated their text without a separator. A table containing `Alpha`, `Beta`, `Gamma`, and `Delta` was therefore analysed as `AlphaBetaGammaDelta` and reported one word. The same bug collapsed adjacent CJK cells into one run with `cjkUnit: "word"`.

- Issue: none; found during repository audit
- Roadmap: n/a
- OpenSpec change: n/a — bug fix with no public API change

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-wordcount`:
  - Preserve a lexical boundary after each `tableCell`.
  - Keep structural boundaries out of character statistics, so `characters` and `charactersNoSpaces` do not gain synthetic whitespace.
  - Count Latin tokens and collapsed CJK runs per lexical segment.
  - Add regression coverage for Latin and CJK GFM tables.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` — 34 files, 539 tests passed
- [x] `pnpm typecheck`
- [x] `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-wordcount build`
- [x] New regression tests: `packages/plugin-wordcount/test/count.test.ts`
- [x] Regression proof: before the fix both new cases reported `1`; after the fix they report `4`.
- [ ] Manual UI check: n/a — pure statistics helper, no UI changes

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — pending first-time contributor check
- [ ] **AI disclosure**: functional implementation was developed with Codex assistance.
      AI-assisted notes: Codex assisted with repository audit, root-cause analysis, implementation, regression tests, validation, and PR drafting. This PR is intentionally draft so the contributor can review and defend every change before marking it ready.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes: none
- [x] `live-preview-table.ts`: not touched
- [x] New capability / breaking change: none; OpenSpec not required
- [x] Change aligns with project scope

## Review guide

The key invariant is that table cell boundaries affect word tokenisation only. Character counts continue to reflect extracted prose characters and do not include synthetic separators.
